evidence: To determine film chemical composition, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was performed... To elucidate the stoichiometry of the as grown Lu silicate layers, Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) analysis was performed... To determine film morphology, atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurements were performed... X-ray reflectivity (XRR), grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) were used... The C-V characteristics were acquired... The band offsets of Lu silicates embedded in a MIS structure were determined employing internal photoemission (IPE) spectroscopy measurements...
